title: What is an AI workflow? vs an AI agent | 50agents
description: An AI workflow is a fixed set of steps where one or more steps are done by an AI model. The order never changes; only the AI step uses judgement.
definition: An AI workflow is a fixed set of steps in which one or more steps are done by an AI model, such as reading an email and deciding what kind it is.
The order of steps stays the same on every run; only the AI step uses judgement, and only on its own small part of the work.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet and posted in a Slack channel
example.why: As asked, no step uses AI. Add "with a one-line note on who they are" and the plan gains one AI step that writes the note. Every other step stays fixed, run after run.
